default_thresholds_note: Module 0 default thresholds. Applied by the application layer from admin config, NOT baked as UDF defaults (the UDF takes thresholds explicitly so a growth lead can tune aggressiveness without a SQL deploy). Under these defaults, the three canonical fixture borrowers B-48291/B-48294/B-48295 all evaluate TRUE — preserving the system contract of 'act on these now.'

cases.note: Happy path: both axes well above threshold. TRUE.
Strong spread but insufficient equity. ITM requires BOTH conditions; one FALSE collapses the flag to FALSE.
Strong equity but insufficient rate spread. Mirror of case_02; pins the AND.
Boundary: spread EXACTLY equals threshold. The >= contract means exact equality is IN. Flipping to strict > would fail this case loudly.
Boundary: equity EXACTLY equals threshold. Same >= pin on the equity axis.
NULL spread -> FALSE. Unknown must not silently become GO for outreach.
NULL equity -> FALSE. Symmetric safety pin.
Custom (stricter) threshold. Same inputs as B-48291 (88 bps, 46% equity) but admin has raised min_spread_bps to 150 -> FALSE. Proves thresholds come from the caller, not baked constants.
Fixture borrower B-48291 under default thresholds + fn_rate_spread output. 88 >= 75 AND 46 >= 15 -> TRUE. Equity = round(100 * (1 - 340000/625000)) = 46. Preserves 'act on these now' system contract.
Fixture borrower B-48294 under default thresholds. 188 >= 75 AND 39 >= 15 -> TRUE. Equity = round(100 * (1 - 342000/560000)) = 39.
Fixture borrower B-48295 under default thresholds. 162 >= 75 AND 56 >= 15 -> TRUE. Equity = round(100 * (1 - 320000/725000)) = 56. All three fixture borrowers remain ITM -- system contract intact.
